risks.title: Media rights dependency
risks.score_rationale: TKO depends heavily on media rights fees for revenue generation, which can be affected by changes in the media landscape and broadcaster preferences

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The sports and entertainment market is highly competitive, which may affect the company's ability to maintain market share and secure favorable media rights deals

risks.title: Talent and athlete risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO depends on key athletes and talent to generate revenue, which can be affected by injuries, departures or career changes

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO is subject to government regulations and laws that may change, affecting business operations and event permitting

risks.title: Reputation and brand risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO is exposed to reputation risks through athlete conduct, safety incidents, and negative events that could affect brand value and revenue

risks.title: Financial and debt risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO has debt and financial obligations that may be affected by market conditions, interest rate changes, and refinancing requirements
